All 20 functional tests pass. The deliverable is complete.

**`chip8_zai-glm-5.3_01.html`** — a single self-contained CHIP-8 emulator (no external dependencies), verified by a headless test harness (`ch8test.mjs`, `PASS=20 FAIL=0`):

**Interpreter**
- 4 KB memory, font set at 0x050, programs at 0x200; V0–VF, 16-bit I, PC, call stack, delay/sound timers decremented at 60 Hz.
- Full 35-instruction set: all 8xy4–8xy7 arithmetic with VF carry/borrow, SHR/SHL, CALL/RET/JP/JP V0, SE/SNE variants, RND, BCD (Fx33), FX55/FX65, Ex9E/ExA1 key tests, Fx0A key wait, Fx29 font, CLS/RET.
- 64×32 canvas display with pixelated scaling, XOR sprite drawing with horizontal wrap, VF collision flag (verified by drawing the same sprite twice → pixels erased, VF=1).

**Demo ROM** (hand-assembled byte array): draws a 4×4 diamond at (30,14) that moves with keys 2/8/4/6 (up/down/left/right) via XOR erase/redraw — all four movement directions verified programmatically.

**UI (all controls live)**
- Run / Pause / Step / Reset / Demo buttons, ROM file loader, instructions-per-frame slider (adjustable at runtime).
- 16-key keypad shown as a 4×4 grid with PC-keyboard mapping displayed; mouse, touch, and keyboard press/release all reach the emulator.
- Debugger panel: all 16 registers, I, PC, stack contents, and the decoded current instruction (full disassembler); updated every frame.
- Sound timer drives a Web Audio beep.

sprite and moves or reacts to a key, so that the emulator can be tried without any download. Also allow
loading a ROM from a local file.

panel showing the registers, the index register, the program counter, the stack and the decoded current
instruction. Every visible control must work. Deliver the one file `chip8_zai-glm-5.3_01.html`.
